newsitem.title: USA: IVAX gets abbreviated new drug application.
newsitem.headline: IVAX gets abbreviated new drug application.

text.p: IVAX Corp said Wednesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved an abbreviated new drug application for its generic pharmaceutical product nicardipine hydrochloride in 20 mg and 30 mg capsules.
Nicardipine hydrochloride is for the treatment of chronic stable angina and hypertension, and is the generic equivalent of Cardene, marketed by Roche Laboratories, a unit of Roche Holdings Ltd.
The IVAX product will be marketed by its wholly-owned subsidiary, Zenith Goldline Pharmaceuticals, with shipping expected to commence immediately, it said.
